title: runtime admission record
note: Declarative contract, not JSON Schema. tooling/check_admission.py implements standards/agent-adapter.md AD-01..AD-10.

rules.support: supported requires evidence and checked; degraded requires degraded_behavior; unsupported requires refusal; unknown requires a noted verification attempt
rules.admission: refused when any required feature is unknown or unsupported; admitted when every required feature is supported, or degraded with a named degraded_behavior
rules.projection: every projected tool must map to a capability whose support is not unsupported
rules.dates: checked is an ISO date, not in the future, and within max_evidence_age_days for a supported claim
rules.loop_gate: every record declares loop_gate; supported requires evidence naming the pre-dispatch check or hook, degraded requires the narrower behavior plus the CI command that carries the gate, unsupported requires the refusal, unknown requires the attempt (AD-12)
